description: Generates a delayed pulse at the output when triggered by a rising edge on the input

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Input trigger signal. A rising edge starts the delayed pulse sequence.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Output pulse signal. Goes high after the configured delay duration and stays high for the configured pulse duration.

config.name: Duration of delay
config.description: Delay duration before the output pulse is generated after a rising edge on the input

config.name: Duration of output pulse
config.description: Duration of the output pulse that is generated after the delay

state.name: Last input state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the input to detect rising edges
